proposal.inferred_root_cause: gateway-layer fault reported as upi_psp_error while upi:ybl itself is healthy
proposal.reasoning_trace: upi:ybl is healthy on the rolling window at 92% success over 148 attempts against a 91% portfolio baseline, and the only open notice names upi:paytm, a different issuer on the same method. The issuer is answering normally, so a gateway-scoped code with no supporting telemetry is a thin claim: it is the most likely reading, not a confident one. The open notice on upi:paytm is a different issuer and explains nothing here. Attempt 2 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
